translations.literal: Vice Chief Director-in-Chief, Vice Director-in-Chief, section vice directors-in-chief, Secretariat Hall rear-office official supervising the affairs of the Five Sections, seven persons.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Chief Director-in-Chief, Vice Director-in-Chief, section vice directors-in-chief, and Secretariat Hall rear-office official supervising the affairs of the Five Sections received attendant rations for seven persons.

sentences.zh: 逐房副承旨，五人。

translations.literal: Section vice directors-in-chief: five persons.
translations.idiomatic: Section vice directors-in-chief received attendant rations for five persons.

sentences.zh: 中書堂後官至樞密院主事已上，各二人。

translations.literal: From Secretariat Hall rear-office officials down to Military Affairs Bureau chief clerks and above, two persons each.
translations.idiomatic: From Secretariat Hall rear-office officials down to Military Affairs Bureau chief clerks and above, each received attendant rations for two persons.

sentences.zh: 錄事，令史，寄班小底，各一人。

translations.literal: Recorders, clerks, and attached-rank junior attendants: one person each.
translations.idiomatic: Recorders, clerks, and attached-rank junior attendants each received attendant rations for one person.

sentences.zh: 傔人餐錢

translations.literal: Attendants' Meal Money
translations.idiomatic: Attendants' Meal Money

sentences.zh: （中書、樞密、宣微、三司及正刺史已上，皆有衣糧，餘止給餐錢。）〉

translations.literal: (Directors of the Secretariat, Military Affairs, Palatial Commandery, and Three Bureaus and regular prefects and above all received clothing and rations; the rest received only meal money.)
translations.idiomatic: (Directors of the Secretariat, Military Affairs, Palatial Commandery, and Three Bureaus and regular prefects and above all received clothing and rations; lower ranks received meal money only.)

sentences.zh: 自判三館、秘書監、兩製、兩省帶修撰，五千。

translations.literal: From directors of the Three Pavilions and Secretariat down through drafters of the Two Departments bearing compiler status: five thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: From directors of the Three Pavilions and Secretariat down through drafters of the Two Departments bearing compiler status, meal money of five thousand cash was granted.

sentences.zh: （朗中以下帶修撰者三千。）〉

translations.literal: (Bureau directors and below bearing compiler status: three thousand cash.)
translations.idiomatic: (Bureau directors and below bearing compiler status received three thousand cash.)

sentences.zh: 直館閣，校理，史館檢討，校勘，各三千。

translations.literal: Pavilion associates, proofreaders, historiography examiners, and collators: three thousand cash each.
translations.idiomatic: Pavilion associates, proofreaders, historiography examiners, and collators each received three thousand cash in meal money.

sentences.zh: 直龍圖閣，審刑院詳議官，國子監書庫官，五千。

translations.literal: Associate of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, Court for Review of Punishments detailed deliberation officers, and Directorate of Education archive officers: five thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: Associates of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, Court for Review of Punishments detailed deliberation officers, and Directorate of Education archive officers received five thousand cash in meal money.

sentences.zh: （自修撰已上又有職錢五千，校勘已上三千。）〉

translations.literal: (From compilers upward there was also an additional post stipend of five thousand cash; from collators upward three thousand cash.)
translations.idiomatic: (From compilers upward there was also an additional post stipend of five thousand cash; from collators upward, three thousand cash.)

sentences.zh: 京畿諸司庫、務、倉、場監官：朝官自二十千至五千，凡七等。

translations.literal: Capital-district warehouse, service, granary, and market directorate officers: capital officials from twenty thousand down to five thousand cash—seven grades.
translations.idiomatic: Capital-district warehouse, service, granary, and market directorate officers who were capital officials received from twenty thousand down to five thousand cash—seven grades.

sentences.zh: 京官自十五千至三千，凡八等。

translations.literal: Capital officials from fifteen thousand down to three thousand cash—eight grades.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials in these posts received from fifteen thousand down to three thousand cash—eight grades.

sentences.zh: 諸司使、副，閤門通事舍人，承製，崇班，二十千至五千，凡九等，閤門祗候及三班，十五千至三千，凡十等。

translations.literal: Bureau commissioners and deputy commissioners, Gate relay secretaries, Drafting Attendants, Honored Attendants—from twenty thousand down to five thousand cash, nine grades; Gatekeepers and Third-Rank Service—from fifteen thousand down to three thousand cash, ten grades.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau commissioners and deputy commissioners, Gate relay secretaries, Drafting Attendants, and Honored Attendants received from twenty thousand down to five thousand cash in nine grades; Gatekeepers and Third-Rank Service received from fifteen thousand down to three thousand cash in ten grades.

sentences.zh: 內侍，十七千至三千，凡九等。

translations.literal: Inner attendants from seventeen thousand down to three thousand cash—nine grades.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendants received from seventeen thousand down to three thousand cash—nine grades.

sentences.zh: 寄班，八千至五千，凡三等。

translations.literal: Attached rank from eight thousand down to five thousand cash—three grades.
translations.idiomatic: Attached rank received from eight thousand down to five thousand cash—three grades.

sentences.zh: （舊誌訛舛，今並從《兩朝志》。）〉

translations.literal: (The old gazetteer was erroneous; all now follow the Gazetteer of Two Reigns.)
translations.idiomatic: (The old gazetteer was erroneous; all figures now follow the *Gazetteer of Two Reigns*.)

sentences.zh: 茶、酒、廚料之給

translations.literal: Tea, Wine, and Kitchen Supplies
translations.idiomatic: Tea, Wine, and Kitchen Supplies

sentences.zh: 學士、權三司使以上兼秘書監，日給酒自五升至一升，有四等，法、糯酒自一升至二升，有二等。

translations.literal: Academicians and acting Three Bureaus commissioners and above concurrently serving as Secretariat Director: daily wine from five sheng down to one sheng—four grades; legal and glutinous wine from one sheng up to two sheng—two grades.
translations.idiomatic: Academicians and acting Three Bureaus commissioners and above who concurrently served as Secretariat Director received daily wine from five sheng down to one sheng in four grades, and legal and glutinous wine from one sheng up to two sheng in two grades.

sentences.zh: 又宮觀副使，文明殿學士，

translations.literal: Also abbey deputy commissioners and academicians of the Hall for Civil Culture,
translations.idiomatic: Abbey deputy commissioners and academicians of the Hall for Civil Culture also received grants,

sentences.zh: （即觀文。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, the Hall for Viewing Literature.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, the Hall for Viewing Literature.)

sentences.zh: 次政殿大學士，龍圖、樞密直學士，並有給茶。

translations.literal: Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, associate academicians of the Dragon Diagram and Military Affairs, all received tea.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and associate academicians of the Dragon Diagram and Military Affairs all received tea.

sentences.zh: 節度使、副以下，各給廚料米六斗，麵一石二斗。

translations.literal: From military governors and deputy commissioners downward, kitchen-supply grain of six dou and flour of one picul two dou was granted to each.
translations.idiomatic: From military governors and deputy commissioners downward, each was granted kitchen-supply grain of six dou and flour of one picul two dou.

sentences.zh: 薪、蒿、炭、鹽諸物之給

translations.literal: Firewood, Artemisia, Charcoal, and Salt
translations.idiomatic: Grants of Firewood, Artemisia, Charcoal, and Salt

sentences.zh: （宰相舊無，後加。）〉

translations.literal: (Grand councilors formerly received none; later added.)
translations.idiomatic: (Grand councilors had formerly received none; this was later added.)

sentences.zh: 宰相，樞密使，月給薪千二百束。

translations.literal: Grand councilors and Military Affairs commissioners: one thousand two hundred bundles of firewood monthly.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councilors and Military Affairs commissioners each received one thousand two hundred bundles of firewood monthly.

sentences.zh: 參知政事，樞密副使，宣徽使，簽書樞密院事，三司使，三部使，權三司使，四百束。

translations.literal: Vice Grand Councilors, Military Affairs vice commissioners, Palatial Commandery commissioners, Military Affairs signatories, Three Bureaus commissioners, and the three department commissioners and acting Three Bureaus commissioners: four hundred bundles.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councilors, Military Affairs vice commissioners, Palatial Commandery commissioners, Military Affairs signatories, Three Bureaus commissioners, and the three department commissioners and acting Three Bureaus commissioners each received four hundred bundles.

sentences.zh: 三部副使，樞密都承旨，一百五十束。

translations.literal: Deputy commissioners of the three departments and Military Affairs Chief Director-in-Chief: one hundred fifty bundles.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commissioners of the three departments and the Military Affairs Chief Director-in-Chief each received one hundred fifty bundles.

sentences.zh: 樞密副都承旨，中書提點五房，一百束。

translations.literal: Military Affairs Vice Chief Director-in-Chief and Secretariat supervisor of the Five Sections: one hundred bundles.
translations.idiomatic: The Military Affairs Vice Chief Director-in-Chief and the Secretariat supervisor of the Five Sections each received one hundred bundles.

sentences.zh: 開封判官，節度判官，薪二十束，蒿四十束。

translations.literal: Kaifeng assessors and military commissioners' assessors: twenty bundles of firewood and forty bundles of artemisia.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng assessors and military commissioners' assessors each received twenty bundles of firewood and forty bundles of artemisia.

sentences.zh: 開封推官，掌書記，支使，留守、節度推官，防、團軍事判官，薪十五束，蒿三十束。

translations.literal: Kaifeng staff assessors, secretaries, dispatch commissioners, garrison and military staff assessors, and defense and regimentation staff assessors: fifteen bundles of firewood and thirty bundles of artemisia.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifeng staff assessors, secretaries, dispatch commissioners, garrison and military staff assessors, and defense and regimentation staff assessors each received fifteen bundles of firewood and thirty bundles of artemisia.

sentences.zh: 留守判官，薪二十束，蒿三十束，防、團軍事推官，薪十束，蒿二十束。

translations.literal: Garrison assessors: twenty bundles of firewood and thirty bundles of artemisia; defense and regimentation staff assessors: ten bundles of firewood and twenty bundles of artemisia.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison assessors received twenty bundles of firewood and thirty bundles of artemisia; defense and regimentation staff assessors received ten bundles of firewood and twenty bundles of artemisia.

sentences.zh: 宰相，樞密使，歲給炭自十月至正月二百秤，餘月一百秤。

translations.literal: Grand councilors and Military Affairs commissioners: from the tenth month through the first month, two hundred jin of charcoal annually; other months one hundred jin.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councilors and Military Affairs commissioners received two hundred jin of charcoal annually from the tenth month through the first month, and one hundred jin in other months.

sentences.zh: 參知政事，樞密副使，宣徽使，簽書樞密院事，三司使，三部使，三十秤，文明殿學士，資政殿大學士，龍圖閣學士，十五秤。

translations.literal: Vice Grand Councilors, Military Affairs vice commissioners, Palatial Commandery commissioners, Military Affairs signatories, Three Bureaus commissioners, and the three department commissioners: thirty jin; academicians of the Hall for Civil Culture and Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and Dragon Diagram Pavilion: fifteen jin.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councilors, Military Affairs vice commissioners, Palatial Commandery commissioners, Military Affairs signatories, Three Bureaus commissioners, and the three department commissioners received thirty jin; academicians of the Hall for Civil Culture and the Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and Dragon Diagram Pavilion received fifteen jin.

sentences.zh: 都承旨，二十秤。

translations.literal: Chief Director-in-Chief: twenty jin.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Director-in-Chief received twenty jin.

sentences.zh: 給鹽：宰相，樞密使，七石。

translations.literal: Salt grants: grand councilors and Military Affairs commissioners, seven piculs.
translations.idiomatic: For salt grants, grand councilors and Military Affairs commissioners received seven piculs.

sentences.zh: 參知政事，樞密副使，簽書院事，宣微使，三司使，三部使，權三司使，二石。

translations.literal: Vice Grand Councilors, Military Affairs vice commissioners, Military Affairs signatories, Palatial Commandery commissioners, Three Bureaus commissioners, the three department commissioners, and acting Three Bureaus commissioners: two piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councilors, Military Affairs vice commissioners, Military Affairs signatories, Palatial Commandery commissioners, Three Bureaus commissioners, the three department commissioners, and acting Three Bureaus commissioners received two piculs.

sentences.zh: 節度使，七石。

translations.literal: Military governors: seven piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Military governors received seven piculs.

sentences.zh: 掌兵遙領，五石。

translations.literal: Honorary appointees commanding troops: five piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Honorary appointees commanding troops received five piculs.

sentences.zh: 留後，觀察，防禦，團練，刺史，五石。

translations.literal: Military observation deputies, surveillance commissioners, defense commissioners, regimentation commissioners, and prefects: five piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Military observation deputies, surveillance commissioners, defense commissioners, regimentation commissioners, and prefects each received five piculs.

sentences.zh: （掌兵、遙領皆不給。）〉

translations.literal: (Army commanders and honorary appointees received none.)
translations.idiomatic: (Neither army commanders nor honorary appointees received salt grants.)

sentences.zh: 給馬芻粟者，自二十匹至一匹，凡七等。

translations.literal: For official-horse fodder grants, from twenty horses down to one horse—seven grades.
translations.idiomatic: Official-horse fodder was granted on a scale from twenty horses down to one horse—seven grades.

sentences.zh: （其軍職，內侍，三班，伎術，中書，樞密、宣微院侍衛，殿前司，皇城司，內侍省，入內內侍省吏屬借官馬者，其本廄馬芻粟隨給焉。）〉

translations.literal: (For military posts, inner attendants, Third-Rank Service, technical specialists, Secretariat, Military Affairs and Palatial Commandery attendants, Palace Front Command, Imperial City Command, Eunuch Service, Inner Palace Eunuch Service clerical staff borrowing official horses, fodder for horses from their original stables was granted accordingly.)
translations.idiomatic: (For military posts, inner attendants, Third-Rank Service, technical specialists, Secretariat, Military Affairs and Palatial Commandery attendants, Palace Front Command, Imperial City Command, Eunuch Service, and Inner Palace Eunuch Service clerical staff who borrowed official horses, fodder from their original stables was granted accordingly.)

sentences.zh: 給紙者，中書，樞密，宣微，三司，宮觀副使、判官，判官，諫官，皆月給焉。

translations.literal: For paper grants, the Secretariat, Military Affairs, Palatial Commandery, Three Bureaus, abbey deputy commissioners and assessors, assessors, and remonstrance officials—all received monthly grants.
translations.idiomatic: Paper was granted monthly to the Secretariat, Military Affairs, Palatial Commandery, Three Bureaus, abbey deputy commissioners and assessors, assessors, and remonstrance officials.

sentences.zh: （自給茶、酒而下，《兩朝志》無，《三朝志》雖不詳備，亦足以見一代之制雲。）〉

translations.literal: (From tea and wine grants downward, the Gazetteer of Two Reigns has none; although the Gazetteer of Three Reigns is not fully detailed, it is still sufficient to show the institutions of an era.)
translations.idiomatic: (From tea and wine grants downward, the *Gazetteer of Two Reigns* has no entries; although the *Gazetteer of Three Reigns* is not fully detailed, it is still enough to show the institutions of an era.)
